Func - Unflatten Error Handler (Error Cluster).vi

Owning Palette: FuncVI Development

This VI handles an error produced by the Unflatten From String LabVIEW function.

Details

Click the parameters for more information

 

InstanceRef is the reference to the CalcExpress instance that evaluates a CalcExpress expression.
name is not used.
argument number specifies the one-based number of the function argument on which the Unflatten From String error occurred. This value is used to format the error description. If it is less than 1, the argument number will be omitted from the error description.
error status before specifies an error status that could occur before the relevant Unflatten From String function call.
Unflatten Error Cluster can accept error information wired from the Unflatten From String function previously called.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
dup name duplicates a value of name.
error status out indicates an output error status.
Error Cluster out indicates an error condition in the standard error cluster. This output provides standard error out functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.

 

Func - Unflatten Error Handler (Error Cluster).vi - details

The VI is intended for use in FuncVIs.
A FuncVI obtains an argument value in the Flattened-To-String format if the argument type is either one of Complex types or a user-defined data type. The VI tests an error condition returned by the Unflatten From String LabVIEW function, which is used to convert an argument value from the Flattened-To-String format to its native format. If a conversion error status is passed to the VI, it posts the error description to the Error Protocol.

This type of error is atypical. It cannot occur unless a specified argument type mismatches its flattened data. Care must be taken wherever a user-defined data type is bound with flattened data; for example, when returning a FuncVI result.

For details, see the FuncVI Development topic.
